raw_response:
This small plot is just for my family's food, mostly cassava and cocoyam with some vegetables mixed in. I don't buy chemical fertilizer for root crops — it's expensive and my cassava grows well enough with the household refuse and ash I put on it. I use the cassava stems and yam setts I saved from last season, like my mother taught me. With only 0.06 hectares, I can manage the weeding and planting myself with help from my daughter when she visits.
